title: Pilot
caption: Appearance belongs to the preset; stance belongs to Character
intro: One pilot, five poses. The cap, flight jacket and mug identify the person while Character supplies standing, sitting, pointing, steering and holding.
contract: Import Character from slide-shared/character/character and pilot from slide-shared/deep-sea-expedition/cast. The origin is the floor between the feet. The seated pose includes its chair; a console is a separate figure.
